summary: DMFI PAC, the hybrid PAC of Democratic Majority for Israel, endorsed Marni von Wilpert in March 2026 as a "strongly pro-Israel" candidate with "great relationships and records with the community," and reaffirmed the endorsement in June under its "Majority Project" to elect pro-Israel Democrats. Vote for Peace rated her Opposed in the general election. Her campaign platform's only Middle East reference is support for a two-state solution.
